steps.name: apply-stage22b-idf-climate-v6-integration
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=c0be9f78627e24bc65bc9d64981ed0e6c4528189; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage22/apply_stage22b_idf_climate_v6_integration.py > /tmp/apply-stage22b-idf-climate-v6-integration.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage22b-idf-climate-v6-integration.py; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('lib/environment_control/CMakeLists.txt').read_text(); required=['src/climate/ClimateControlLoop.cpp','src/climate/ClimateFeatureEncoder.cpp','src/climate/ClimateRuntimeController.cpp','src/climate/ClimateTrendEstimator.cpp']; assert all(s.count(x)==1 for x in required)"; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage22b-host-build-sanity
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --target climate_v6_tests climate_runtime_parity_tests climate_control_loop_tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^(climate_v6_tests|climate_runtime_parity_tests|climate_control_loop_tests)$' --output-on-failure; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-idf-build-and-publish-stage22b
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; rm -rf build/idf-gate; bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Compile climate-v6 core in ESP-IDF'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
